parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description:
The sorting order of property records in the response. Valid values:

- **0**: in reverse chronological order.
- **1**: in chronological order.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the device that you want to query.

><notice>
 If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the property records to query. The value must be greater than the value of **StartTime**. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description:
The identifier of the property to query.

<props="china">
- You can view the property **Identifier** of a device in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) definition of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) to view it in the returned TSL data.
- You can view the property **Identifier** of a digital twin node in the functional properties of the twin node in the Digital Twin Studio in the IoT Platform console. For more information, see [Functional properties of twin nodes](~~278729~~).

</props>

<props="intl">You can view the property **Identifier** of a device in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) definition of the product to which the device belongs in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) to view it in the returned TSL data.</props>

> If the property is **temperature** under a custom (non-default) module **testFb**, set this parameter to **testFb:temperature**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device<props="china"><ph> or digital twin node</ph></props> whose property you want to query:

<props="china">
- Call the [QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~) operation to query the **IotId** of a specified device.
- In the IoT Platform console, on the **Digital Twin Details** page, click a twin node to view the **Node ID**.

</props>

<props="intl">Call the [QueryDeviceInfo](~~257184~~) operation to query the **IotId** of a specified device.</props>

><notice>**IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or the </ph></props>ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

><notice>
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the property records to query. The value must be less than the value of **EndTime**. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1579249499000.
